name: Stir Fry Express (Rochester location)
whatItIs: Restaurant owned by a father and son who immigrated from Bosnia; a customer said it served Bosnian kebab, bulaklak and baklava. Opened February 2026.
evidence: KTTC, Oct. 9, 2026: sign on the door reads 'Unfortunately we are permanently closed.'

name: Stir Fry Express (Duluth location)
whatItIs: Another location of the same Bosnian-owned business, named by KTTC as one of its storefronts.
evidence: KTTC, Oct. 9, 2026, says other storefronts operate in Sioux Falls and Duluth, but no Duluth address or own page was found.

name: Northgate Imports Inc
whatItIs: Used foreign vehicles, repair and service; opened in early 2010 by Bosnian immigrant Nedzad Nukic, per the Post Bulletin in 2011.
evidence: CarEdge dealer listing checked Oct. 31, 2026 shows 30 vehicles currently in stock. Current ownership was not confirmed; the Bosnian ownership is from a 2011 article.

name: Europe Grocery Store
neighborhoodOrCity: 1109 Seventh St. NW, Rochester (across from Northgate Plaza)
whatItIs: European grocery planned in 2011 by two Bosnian immigrants to carry cevapi, spices, candies and juices from the Bosnian region.
evidence: Only source is an Oct. 23, 2011 article about plans to open by mid-November 2011. No later page found.

name: Intercultural Mutual Assistance Association (IMAA) Language Services
whatItIs: Refugee and immigrant service agency founded 1984 that helped resettle Bosnians; led by Bosnian former refugee Armin Budimlic; offers interpreting and translation in multiple languages.
evidence: Own site shows current programs, staff page lists Armin Budimlic as executive director, interpreter request forms and events.
